basis: Curtiss-Wright publicly established the decline by May 4, 2022. Consolidated reported net sales for the three months ended March 31, 2022 were $559,461,000 versus $597,059,000 a year earlier, down 6.30% and $7,745,050 below the $567,206,050 cutoff. The earliest date remains unresolved because the substantive March 17 management discussion could not be verified. The upper bound records the verified actual.

coverage.detail: November 3, 2021 Q3 release. Management updated its FY2021 adjusted outlook. It gave no consolidated Q1 2022 sales ceiling.
November 4 Q3 call deck. The 7%–9% total sales growth forecast compared adjusted FY2021 with adjusted FY2020.

Additional earlier event. The November 9 issuer notice scheduled a November 11 CEO/CFO fireside chat at Baird and offered a replay for approximately 30 days. The notice contains no Q1 sales forecast. I could verify the event listing but could not recover an official recording or transcript.
February 23, 2022 Q4 release. The $2.530 billion–$2.580 billion sales range covered FY2022 on an adjusted basis. The release supplied no Q1 sales allocation.
February 24 Q4 call deck. Slides 6–7 forecast annual sales growth of 3%–5%. The Q1-specific comparison on slide 7 concerned EPS.

Secondary transcript of the February 24 call. CFO Chris Farkas estimated Q1 adjusted diluted EPS at approximately $1.20 and described Q1 as the lightest quarter. Neither statement fixes a dollar or percentage ceiling for Q1 reported sales.

Official earnings-call archive check. The Q3 and Q4 2021 webcast cells point back to the quarterly-results page. They did not yield historical audio. The release and presentation PDFs are separately listed.

March 2 Form 8-K and exhibits concern the preliminary proxy statement, Saddle Point director nominations and communications to management and employees. The preliminary announcement supplied no Q1 sales figure.
March 9 exhibit announced the withdrawal of Saddle Point's proposals and nominees. It supplied no Q1 sales range.

March 15 issuer notice scheduled the CEO and CFO for a public March 17 fireside chat at 12:30 p.m. ET. It specified no formal presentation, referenced the latest investor slides and offered a replay for approximately 30 days. The notice itself contains no Q1 sales bound.

Issuer archive rescue. The accessible event listings did not expose the March 17 recording or identify the exact slide deck available that day. The June 2022 investor deck found in search postdates the actual results.
Historical issuer-site rescue. The Wayback availability request for the legacy IR events page was inaccessible in this search. I could not establish whether a snapshot preserves the webcast link.

Conference-host rescue. A same-conference issuer listing identified this BofA/VeraCast event directory. The directory was inaccessible, and the host search yielded no Curtiss-Wright session recording or transcript.

The webcast link on Jacobs' March 15 conference listing returned a cache miss. It identifies the conference platform but belongs to Jacobs. A session-specific URL for Curtiss-Wright could not be verified.

March 17 transcript preview confirms the event occurred at 16:30 GMT. Curtiss-Wright IR officer Jim Ryan mentioned the Q1 2022 outlook in the opening safe-harbor statement. The public text ends before management's substantive remarks and Q&A, leaving any sales guidance unknown.

The intervening issuer archive lists a March 24 technical announcement, the April 7 earnings scheduling notice and April 20 and May 3 contract announcements. No preliminary Q1 earnings release was identified.

May 4 actuals. The consolidated earnings table gives net sales in thousands of 559,461 and 597,059. The reconciliation deducts 7,102 from prior-year reported sales, including the German valves divestiture adjustment, to reach 589,957 adjusted. The reported-to-reported threshold uses 597,059.
Item 2.02 identifies May 4 as the release date and May 5 as the scheduled results call.

publication_date_evidence: The actual-results exhibit is datelined May 4, 2022, corroborated by Item 2.02 of the Form 8-K filed May 5. May 4 is verified for publication of actuals. The missing March 17 remarks prevent establishing it as the earliest qualifying disclosure.
